title: Logs silently stop at 200 rows and the counts read as totals
what_happens: The query has .limit(200). The chip reads 'success 200' for a session that has 522 calls, and there is no 'showing latest 200' note, no paging and no 'load more'. Counts are also computed from the filtered rows, so they change meaning as you filter.
who_hurts: Dane reading error rates or looking for an older call thinks he sees everything; calls older than the latest 200 are unreachable from the UI.
suggested_fix: Get real totals with a count query (or label 'latest 200 of 522'), and add a simple 'Older →' link with a before=<created_at> param. logs/page.tsx:91, :99.
rule: general: don't present a truncated list as complete
